name: Virag 3D Creative Library
description: Dedicated still-image CGI and 3D advertising presets. This library is independent from the generic Creative Library and Video Library.

commands.label: 3D Product Hero
commands.desc: Premium CGI hero composition built around the exact uploaded product
commands.prompt: Create a premium high-end 3D product hero creative using the current uploaded product as the exact immutable visual reference. Build one strong commercial composition with believable scale, contact shadows, premium materials, cinematic lighting, controlled depth, and a memorable advertising focal point. Preserve packaging geometry, label, logo, colors, proportions, and visible details exactly.

commands.label: 3D Product Universe
commands.desc: Immersive brand-specific CGI world surrounding the product
commands.prompt: Create an immersive 3D product universe around the exact uploaded product. Translate visible brand/category cues into architecture, materials, atmosphere, props, scale, and spatial storytelling without redesigning the product. Use clear foreground, midground, and background depth and make the product the unmistakable hero.

commands.label: Anamorphic 3D OOH
commands.desc: Forced-perspective 3D billboard illusion with dramatic depth
commands.prompt: Create a premium anamorphic 3D OOH creative where the current product appears to break beyond a billboard/display plane through controlled forced perspective. Keep the product exact, maintain physically believable depth and shadows, and design the illusion for one strong viewing angle without turning it into a generic billboard mockup.

commands.label: Chrome Sculpture
commands.desc: Reflective chrome-led 3D campaign world
commands.prompt: Create a sophisticated chrome-led 3D advertising scene around the exact product. Use reflective sculptural forms, controlled specular highlights, premium studio lighting, and deliberate negative space. Keep chrome as the surrounding campaign material language; do not recolor or chrome-coat the locked product itself.

commands.label: Glass Sculpture
commands.desc: Transparent glass and refractive 3D environment
commands.prompt: Create a premium refractive glass 3D world around the exact product using transparent sculptural forms, realistic refraction, caustic-style lighting, subtle condensation or optical distortion where appropriate, and strong depth. Preserve the product exactly and keep glass effects on the environment rather than distorting the product.

commands.label: Liquid Sculpture
commands.desc: Controlled liquid simulation built as a premium advertising form
commands.prompt: Create a high-end 3D liquid-sculpture advertising creative around the current product. Use one controlled fluid gesture with believable viscosity, splash shape, droplets, contact, and lighting. Match the liquid behavior to the product/category where appropriate while preserving the product and avoiding chaotic generic splashes.

commands.label: 3D Exploded View
commands.desc: Premium separated-component visualization without unsupported claims
commands.prompt: Create a premium 3D exploded-view creative of the supplied object only when its visible or supplied components support it. Separate parts cleanly along a logical axis, preserve geometry and materials, use technical-commercial lighting, and avoid inventing hidden internals, ingredients, mechanisms, or components that are not supplied.

commands.label: 3D X-Ray
commands.desc: Translucent technical visualization with source-safe internals
commands.prompt: Create a sophisticated 3D X-ray/translucent visualization of the current object using only visible or supplied structural information. Use transparent shells, controlled glow, technical depth cues, and clean composition. Never fabricate hidden internals or functional claims.

commands.label: 3D Macro Detail
commands.desc: Extreme CGI close-up focused on materials and craftsmanship
commands.prompt: Create an extreme 3D macro advertising creative focused on one visually important material, surface, label detail, edge, texture, or construction feature from the current reference. Keep the source geometry and branding accurate, use physically believable micro-detail and lighting, and make the frame feel intentionally designed rather than simply zoomed in.

commands.label: Zero-Gravity Product
commands.desc: Dynamic floating CGI composition with believable balance
commands.prompt: Create a premium zero-gravity 3D advertising composition with the exact product suspended in a believable dynamic arrangement. Use supporting objects or particles only when relevant, maintain realistic scale and perspective, and create visual motion through composition rather than physically impossible product deformation.

commands.label: Surreal 3D Concept
commands.desc: Reality-bending but physically coherent brand-specific CGI idea
commands.prompt: Create one surreal 3D campaign concept around the exact current product. Bend scale, environment, gravity, architecture, or material behavior in one memorable way while keeping the product itself accurate and the scene visually coherent. Avoid random fantasy clutter; the surreal idea must support the product/category.

commands.label: Monumental Architecture
commands.desc: Product integrated into a large-scale architectural CGI world
commands.prompt: Create a monumental 3D architectural advertising scene where the exact product is integrated into or framed by large-scale designed architecture. Use believable scale references, strong perspective, premium materials, controlled lighting, and a clear visual path to the product. Do not turn the product itself into a building unless explicitly requested.

commands.label: 3D Typography
commands.desc: Sculptural typography integrated with the product world
commands.prompt: Create a 3D typography-led advertising creative where a short supported headline or non-factual campaign hook becomes a sculptural spatial element around the exact product. Use real depth, material, lighting, occlusion, and hierarchy. Keep text readable and do not invent factual claims.

commands.label: Mechanical World
commands.desc: Precision-engineered gears, structures, and mechanisms as visual language
commands.prompt: Create a precision-engineered 3D mechanical campaign world around the exact product using believable machined forms, gears, rails, frames, pistons, or engineered structures as visual language. Do not imply that these are actual product internals unless supplied; they are environmental storytelling elements only.

commands.label: Energy Field
commands.desc: Controlled volumetric energy and particle CGI around the product
commands.prompt: Create a premium 3D energy-field advertising creative around the exact product using controlled volumetric light, particles, trails, arcs, or pressure-wave forms. Keep the energy physically coherent and visually purposeful; never convert the effect into unsupported performance or scientific claims.

commands.label: Sculptural Pedestal
commands.desc: Designed exhibition pedestal and premium gallery-style CGI
commands.prompt: Create a premium 3D exhibition-style product display with a custom sculptural pedestal, designed backdrop, strong material contrast, believable contact, and refined gallery lighting. Make the pedestal/category language distinctive rather than using a generic cylinder podium.

commands.label: Portal Reveal
commands.desc: Dimensional portal framing the product as a campaign reveal
commands.prompt: Create a still-image 3D portal/reveal concept where the exact product is framed by or emerging through a designed dimensional opening. Use believable perspective, depth, contact, light spill, atmosphere, and a clear visual transition between spaces. Keep it as one finished still creative, not a storyboard.

commands.label: Inflatable World
commands.desc: Soft inflated sculptural environment with premium art direction
commands.prompt: Create a sophisticated inflatable 3D campaign environment around the exact product using soft volumetric forms, realistic seams or pressure behavior where visible, premium soft-light reflections, and intentional composition. Preserve the product itself as rigid and accurate unless its real material is soft.

commands.label: Material Terrain
commands.desc: Brand-relevant terrain built from a signature material or ingredient cue
commands.prompt: Create a cinematic 3D terrain/world around the exact product using one brand- or category-relevant material cue derived from the current reference. Build believable scale, surface detail, depth, atmosphere, and product integration without inventing factual ingredients or product claims.

commands.label: Minimal 3D Art
commands.desc: Quiet premium CGI with one sculptural idea and strong negative space
commands.prompt: Create a minimal premium 3D advertising creative using the exact product plus one strong sculptural idea. Use restrained materials, precise lighting, sophisticated negative space, controlled shadows, and exceptional composition. Avoid clutter, generic podiums, and unnecessary effects.
